'''Ben Shanks''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[2001 South Carolina State Championship]] on 12 May 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court]] and [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|Hidden Mains]], according to Brad Reinhold's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2370">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-25-greenville-sc-5-12-01d2370/ greenville-sc-5-12-01], DeckTech (Brad "Admiral Twk" Reinhold, 25 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-25-greenville-sc-5-12-01d2370/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
